full_page.content:
1945, December
The following is a faithful transcription of photo copies of handwritten messages on Seraphic Mass Association Cards by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
Miss Doris Panyard For God's holy guidance. Dec. 5th, 1945
God bless you Doris P. Shake off - worry.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
Pray for the poor big sinner down here at St. Michaels. He too sometimes feel ...? But what can I do ? ....? 0! I just think: "some day it will be over" and then we'll get HOME.'
God bless you again
Fr. S.
George L. Panyard -- -- for the Poor Holy Souls -- special Intentions -- Dec. 11th, 1945
God bless you George, you and yours all around
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap. Hope the Holy Souls - -- especially who in any way have helped and been in- terested - may still show their interest.
The original in possession of: Doris Panyard 3248 Maple Grove Rd. Apt. 27 Muskegon, Mich. 49441
